notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey while I've been working on finishing Color Fear i had a thought that maybe with all the updates that I've been making on the basic features, intruders and other things, that i should probably update the demo with these features too! Hopefully you guys can enjoy this final demo update. [/p][p][/p][p]This demo closer reflects what the final game will feel like.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm very grateful for all the love and support to the project! So on demo completion there is a special flying game mode that has been added for you to enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]Also on demo completion there is also a replay mode that allows you to restart the week without resetting your night points or inventory items.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist to support Color Fear! Thanks![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Features:[/b][/p][p]-Updated Overall Visuals to make the project feel more immersive[/p][p]-Flashlight now has a more realistic affect on world and can cast more realistic shadows and will also sway idly.[/p][p]-Scary Random Noise System has been added[/p][p]-Updated Intruder Visuals[/p][p]-Controller UI Selection actually works now[/p][p]-Jumpscare System has been added![/p][p]-At Completion of Demo 2 New Game Modes[/p][p]-Fly Mode: Enjoy flying as long as you want![/p][p]-Replay Mode: replay from the beginning of the week without losing your night points or inventory items.[/p][p]-Ghost and Intruders can now roam the building[/p][p]-Updated Item Visuals[/p][p]-Card Use VFX[/p][p]-Inventory System Actually Works and you can drop and pickup items seamlessly[/p][p]-Updated Safe Card Cross VFX[/p][p]-More Specific Death Messaging[/p][p]-Fixed a lot of bugs[/p]

notes.title: Color Fear Joins Indie Assemble
notes.content:
Color Fear joins Indie Assemble, a special steam festival brought to you by Excaliber!

Indie Assemble will be taking place from May 5th to May 11th on Steam.

[list]
[*] Excaliber Website: https://excaliber.it/en/

I cant wait for you guys to see what will come from Color Fear!

notes.title: Color Fear Release Date Update!
notes.content:
Hey thanks for all the love and support on the Color Fear Project! 

I know i said Color Fear would release at the end of April but it needs a bit more time to be finished. 

I was gonna do this as a video but I'm still currently sweating from the gym and that would or might be cringe anyways this is very sincere.

Color Fear needs a bit more time to be finished so the release will still be in Q2 this year but when......

(Tune into the OTK Games Expo Preshow May 25th for an update!)

Thanks for All the Love and support!

To the people that are or will enjoy this project in the future thank you!!!

notes.title: Color Fear Act 1 Updates!
notes.content:
[b]A lot of Updates for Color Fear Act 1![/b]

[list]

[*] Major visual bug glitch fixed, the game now looks as intended and the tv isn't annoyingly bright at points and colorless looks better!

[*] Some Night Shop items are cheaper

[*] 10% bigger light switches they also now glow just a bit so they can be seen easier

[*] Scream Specific Audio Setting added in settings menu

[*] fixed find basement bug where they just stand there and do nothing

[*] Gamma bar added in settings

[*] New Visuals for Youth Level

[*] Some Improvements to tutorial wording

[*] Fixed tv show rankings not showing up for phone level

[*] TV can be set even after color is shown

[*] statue now screams only 50% of the time not all the time
[/list]

I'm going to keep on fixing bugs tomorrow too for Act 1 then ill continue to work on Act 2 which will hopefully release around a month from now! 

I also want to say a thank you to everyone who has covered the project and to all who will in the future i appreciate you so much thank you! - Johnny

notes.title: Brighter Flashlight Brighter Greatness!
notes.content:
Default Flashlight has been upgraded to be 2.5x Brighter and the distance has been upgraded 3x
Thanks for all the love and feedback and responses! i hope you enjoy this project. Sometimes i gotta put what i think aside and listen to people i care for and make changes so they can enjoy this project as best as possible!

- flashlight has become 2.5x Brighter and 3x further
- added continue button
- added begin button that allows you to play color fear again keeping your night points and inventory!
- added gamma adjustment in settings!
- added Photo intruder
- also updated house lighting to be more clear in larger areas
- added ghost that walks around house to make you feel like there is an intruder

- fixed enemy ghosting effect looking like camouflage
- fixed orange spawning other enemies as the same time
- fixed basement intruder bug that made it un-collideable
